name: Sin Fetish Audio
author: Sin Fetish Audio
tagline: VISITORS: Greys, Reptilians, Nordics, Mantis and the Ship
description: Five visitors in one groovebox: Nordics (poly synth), Mantis (synthesized drums), Reptilians (bass and lead), Greys (sampler, granular to come), and the Ship (sequencer with scenes and a song). MIDI channels 1-4 play Nordics, Mantis, Reptilians, Greys.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
